3. **Subsurface scattering, the first of Decision 16's spectral experiments (Decision 18), in three
   batches, each measured, what of its first batch stands alone committed before item 2 begins; done
   at `42b3e9ce`.** A material gains what skin, wax, marble and a leaf have, a subsurface color and
   a radius in world units with a thickness scale for its thin parts, set in the flat API as the
   material's other fields are and read from a glTF file's `KHR_materials_volume` thickness where it
   has one. First, the diffusion: light that enters leaves nearby, so the lit light of the marked
   pixels is spread along a profile of the material's color and radius in a separable screen-space
   pass over the HDR frame, the specular kept out of it where the frame has it apart, masked so an
   unmarked pixel is never touched and the spread never crosses a depth edge, with a test of a lit
   sphere whose terminator softens and bleeds the color where the unmarked sphere beside it does
   not, read at pixels as the occlusion tests read theirs. Second, the light that comes through: a
   thin part lit from behind shows the light on its front, the thickness toward the light read from
   the scene's distance field, which has it for nothing where the field is fine, and from the sun's
   shadow depth where it is coarse, with a test of a thin sheet lit from behind brighter on its
   front where it is thin than where it is thick. Third, the tiers: sample counts and a half-size
   pass at Low and the full at High, as the bounce is tiered, the kernels in Slang so the bridge
   runs them in BevyCSharp once proven here, the GPU cost of each batch on Manor and on the test
   scene in RENDERING.md and the comparison page, the guide's section and TODO.md's entry. Each
   batch a commit of its own with its numbers, and what does not pay a measured share stays
   described. The second batch is in at `d885c89e`, the light that comes through. The third brings
   the tiers as a setting of their own, `SetSubsurfaceQuality` with Low, Medium and High and High

## Verdicts

Verdicts 56 to 98 are settled, said under each in REVIEW-ARCHIVE.md; Verdict 99 is open.

99. **The run of `dfbf7614` is red on the first Windows half alone, the leak test's reading catching
    an app not yet torn down.** Read at 17:50 on 2026-11-02, the first run with the Windows suite in
    two jobs, half 1 red in 69 minutes on one test of Core, AppLeakTests' hundred offscreen apps,
    half 2 green in 90, Linux in 97 and macOS in 40, so the halves read under their limits of 120
    and item 183 holds. The test expects the process's growth under 50 MB from the most of its
    readings at the tenth, twentieth and thirtieth app, 92.4 MB, and read 208.0 at the fortieth and
    213.2 at the seventieth where the fiftieth and sixtieth read 96.1 and 100.1 and the heap's live
    objects held at 18.5 to 18.9 MB throughout; an app's life commits about 188 MB between its
    device made and destroyed, and the threads of six apps were still running half a second after
    their apps ended, so a reading taken while an app's device is not yet torn down sees that app's
    memory, not a leak. The same test failed the push run of `3dda52c2` and passed its pack run
    (Verdict 97's note), so it is the reading's moment. The mend is in the test, each reading taken
    once the apps' threads have ended and the device is destroyed, or the growth read from the
    medians of the readings rather than their most, with the reason in its remarks; one commit, test
    only, before 186's commit. `f8872d03` and `11b6a593` are held and go up with it. Settled by that
    run's half 1 green.

    GTK plugin, installed on the owner's machine, draws a GTK3-style frame with rounded top corners,
    square bottom corners and its own drop shadow inside the app. Item 92; the user's own
    environment variable keeps precedence, and a session without X11 falls back to what SDL finds.

`GetPhysicsJointForce` (`fdcfd435`), the impulse Bepu keeps for the joint's own constraint over the

Shared: the screen's probes are looked up along the normal turned to the eye as the shading's is,
so the back of a two-sided face takes the probes standing on it, where along its front's normal it

the half-cell bands of the field's two-sided faces meet and a screen probe's rays take their own
wall's light, 44% over a path-traced reference, which item 131 reads.

and the probe keeps up to sixteen frames of its light before the window's filter, fewer where its
kept light lies past three times the error of its like neighbors' blend, which took the bounce
rooms' still spots from 4 to 24 a view to 4 to 17, a still view's change at its 99th part 2.6% at
most (item 135).

Shared: the driver's compiled pipelines are kept in the program's cache folder between runs, a

On 167, the reference's exposure at 15:00 is HDRP's default profile's automatic mode,
center-weighted between EV -1 and 14 at adaptation 3 and 1, not the histogram the item names. The
scene's global volume holds the look, the gamma and the bloom and no exposure, and the night volume
holding the histogram between EV 4 and 14 with a look of its own, `AgX - Low Contrast - Night.exr`,

reflected the environment's light alone read the grazing floor 0.093 to 0.116 of its light apart and

Shared: a rough surface reflects the light the world's probes hold along its mirror way (item 172's
second part, `reflectedAt` in `roughreflect.slang`), each probe's light gathered about eight by eight
directions through a lobe of cosine to the 8, in blocks with DDGI's border across the octahedron's
edges, its reach read filtered, mixed toward its faces as the roughness goes from 0.5 to 1, and the
environment's reflection by the probes' share of the sky kept under 0.25. Against references with
the first face's specular share, the Cornell box's red and green walls read 3% over and 1% under
where 28% and 22% under, and Sponza's floor 8 and 20% under where 12 and 36%. The specular share
itself, Karis's fit for mobile, reads 10 to 15% under GGX's albedo at roughness 0.5 and 25% over at
1, which a split-sum table is to replace (172's third part).

Shared: the share of the light from all around that a surface reflects by its specular lobe is read
from the split sum's table, 32 by 32 texels made once when the renderer first draws
(`SpecularShares`, item 172's third part), GGX's lobe integrated by 1,024 half ways a texel with
Smith's height-correlated shadowing, in every indirect specular term where Karis's fit for mobile
stood. The emissive metal box's wall seen square on reads 1.827 where the reference reads 1.832 and

RENDERING.md.

Shared: the ambient occlusion is ground-truth ambient occlusion over the window's half-size depth in
place of Alchemy's spiral (item 173, `ao.slang`), two slices a pixel turned each frame by
interleaved gradient noise and the frame's number, four steps a side with XeGTAO's falloff, a
history of half floats keeping 0.9 of what each texel's point held the frame before through the
frame before's view-projection where the depth along the view agrees within 5%, then the two blurs.
Where light bounces the field's occlusion is left out, since the cascades hold it. In the Cornell
box at a radius of 0.5 each wall's light at its edges over its inside reads the reference's within
0.005 where it read 0.027 to 0.037 over, the ceiling's 0.017 under where 0.027, and in Sponza's door
view the pattern of nine surfaces of ten moves toward the reference's, each surface's level 4 to 15%
lower (`build/region-pattern.py`). The pass takes 0.07 ms at 1920 by 1080 past the sun's contact
shadows, where Alchemy's with the field's took 0.12 to 0.14.

before's shadow pass drew it, where one of the map's counted cascades holds the hit, and through

Shared: each world probe's reach is kept at sixteen by sixteen directions of its octahedron where it
was eight by eight (item 185), so a cascade of sixteen directions a side keeps each ray's own
distance where a direction took the mean of four rays some 25 degrees across. The closed corridor's
far end, in the fourth cascade with probes sixteen units apart, read 0.499 of its open light, the
outside probes' rays that passed beside it and those that met its walls blended into a reach that

Shared: temporal antialiasing (item 174) moves the window's camera by a part of a pixel after the
projection and draws the depth the screen's passes read through the camera without the move, the
sun's cascades fitted to it too, so the occlusion, the screen's probes and the reflections hold
still under it and only the frame's own edges move. The resolve weighs light by one over one more
than its luma times the exposure the frame will be shown at, which an engine whose light is in
physical units needs, and starts a pixel's history again where the frame before's depth, written
beside the history, saw something nearer.

Shared: volumetric fog (item 175) is a volume of cells, a tile of sixteen pixels by 64 slices growing
with their distance to the far plane or 128 units, lit by the sun through the shadow map drawn that
frame and by the world's probes' irradiance up and down, summed from the eye as Hillaire sums
Frostbite's, and laid over the scene as it is decoded to linear light, so bloom, the exposure,
temporal antialiasing and the reflections read the scene in fog. HDRP's fog maps onto it as a
density of one over the mean free path, thinning by e every 0.144765 of the maximum height.
